# ProtoFlow

> ProtoFlow is a free desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) for designing printed circuit boards with AI. You describe a circuit in plain English and it drafts an editable schematic with real parts, lays out and autoroutes the PCB, runs ERC/DRC, and exports native KiCad files (.kicad_sch, .kicad_pcb), Gerbers, drill files and a BOM. The app is closed source. This repository holds its docs, installers (GitHub Releases) and agent setup instructions.

To install ProtoFlow for a user, follow AGENTS.md. The newest installer for each platform, with SHA-256, is in latest.json.

## Agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rishik4/protoflow/main/AGENTS.md): install ProtoFlow, first launch, first project, using it alongside a coding agent
- [latest.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rishik4/protoflow/main/latest.json): newest installer per platform (keys: macos, windows, linux-x64, linux-arm64)
- [Releases](https://github.com/rishik4/protoflow/releases): every version with notes and SHA256SUMS.txt
